_comment: Plan 0073 D2. `base` is every Claude runner's sandbox; `runners` holds the per-runner overlay (its own model endpoint, and any credential variable stripped from the shell). Read by sandbox_settings() in bin/orchestrator. sandbox.enabled is FALSE: measured 2026-10-11 on CLI 2.1.296, enabling it with this allowlist refuses loopback :8200, ssh :3022 and writes to the shared .git-store, so every dispatch would fail at the push. Enable only after the docs/implementer-sandbox.md measurement is redone. allowUnsandboxedCommands is false so the model cannot retry a refusal with dangerouslyDisableSandbox.
